text_block_list.text:
One afternoon—I happened upon Mejiro 
McQueen and Mejiro Ardan diligently 
practicing their dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ardan-san, I humbly ask for your guidance 
and instruction today, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I must train rigorously in preparation for 
the ball. Please do not hesitate to be 
strict with me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. But let us make sure not to 
stiffen your shoulders too much, alright? 
Now then—let us begin with the waltz.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, one, two, three... gh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Be mindful of a graceful swing. Pay close 
attention to each individual step...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, you have improved considerably. It 
is like night and day compared to when you 
were a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...You used to teach me just like this so 
often, didn't you? How nostalgic, desu wa—

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ouch...! Ugh... again... *sniff*... I 
don't wanna do this anymore...

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen... Shall we call it a day here, 
then? We can continue another time—

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—N-No! I want to be able to do it 
properly!

text_block_list.name: Young McQueen
text_block_list.text:
B-But... my steps aren't syncing up at 
all... What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Young Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, it is alright, calm down. Try to 
feel your partner's movements and 
breathing more. I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Back then... I was so desperate to act 
mature. Yet, I couldn't completely cast 
aside my childish reliance on others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... You have always been brimming with 
more sense of responsibility and 
hardworking spirit than anyone else, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Even if you were merely stretching 
yourself at first... you have now grown 
capable of shouldering the Mejiro name on 
your own. —You are truly admirable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(That's right... Ardan-san has always 
stood by my side like this ever since we 
were young.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(In painful times, and in joyous times... 
It has always been so warm—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
............Um, Ardan-san. There is 
something that I had always wished to ask 
you back then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —? What might that be...? Please, tell me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well... the truth is, I wanted to... even 
more... together with you, Ardan-san...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I wanted to dance with you, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Your steps are always so splendid and 
beautiful. I wanted to stand side-by-side 
with you... forgetting the passage of 
time... and dance—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, my hesitation always got the 
better of me, and I could never bring 
myself to say it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...So... would it be alright if I asked 
you... now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —...Fufu. Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You always carry out your duties as though 
they were "only natural," but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Consistently maintaining that posture is 
not something just anyone can do... I take 
great pride in your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Seeing your dignified grace 
has caused me to straighten my own posture 
time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ahem. Ardan-san, surely that is a bit too 
much praise, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, if anything, words alone are not 
nearly enough. —If you doubt me, shall we 
put it to the test?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Beautiful... —Since we are having such a 
lovely time, would you like to try dancing 
a tango as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —! By all means, desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It is quite challenging, but I know you 
can do it now. Expanding your repertoire 
will surely give you even greater 
confidence for the upcoming party.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes—! I shall master it without fail, and 
fulfill my duties to perfection, desu wa.
